selection: all ACTIVE or PENDING_RETURN orders without an existing contract segment and with complete authoritative contract and commercial facts

lock.transactionBoundary: one serializable transaction per deterministic orderId; earlier candidates remain committed if a later candidate fails

cancellation: cancel before each per-order commit; interruption after any candidate begins is outcome-unknown and requires same-operation reconcile
idempotency: orderId plus sequenceNo createMany conflict handling and exact candidate comparison prevent duplicate BASE segments and audits
checksums: candidate digests bind exact order, segment order, dates, commercial amounts, contract identity and snapshots and are recomputed under row locks
exitCondition: retire after all supported active subscriptions have authoritative BASE contract segments
